name: Aman Tokyo
insider_take: Aman Tokyo transforms the traditional Japanese ryokan concept into a towering urban sanctuary, where minimalist luxury meets the pulse of the world's largest metropolis.
whats_special: Occupying the top six floors of the Otemachi Tower, this architectural marvel features rooms with soaring 30-foot ceilings and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the Imperial Palace Gardens. The hotel's stone and timber interiors channel ancient Japanese aesthetics while the signature Aman Spa spans an entire floor with traditional hot and cold plunge pools.
pro_tip: Book a corner suite facing east for unobstructed sunrise views over the Imperial Palace moats – a sight reserved for emperors that's now yours to enjoy from your private haven 160 feet above Tokyo's streets.
dont_miss: The hotel's location in Otemachi places you at Tokyo's financial heart, mere steps from Tokyo Station and the entrance to the East Gardens of the Imperial Palace. Visit the nearby Nihonbashi district, Tokyo's historic commercial center where distances throughout Japan were once measured, and experience kaiseki dining at the hotel's restaurant featuring ingredients from the legendary Tsukiji Outer Market.
pros: Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with traditional Japanese treatments
Prime location in Otemachi financial district near Imperial Palace
Ultra-spacious rooms and suites with floor-to-ceiling windows
Impeccable Japanese hospitality and attention to detail
Stunning city and Imperial Palace gardens views
cons: Limited dining options within the hotel
